description: This source file defines the `ChatMarkdownPreprocessor` enum in Swift, which provides static methods to process and clean up Markdown chat messages. The processing includes removing envelope headers, message ID hints, inbound context blocks, timestamps, and extracting inline images embedded as base64 data URIs.

classes.name: InlineImage
classes.description: A struct representing an inline image extracted from markdown, with a label and optional image data.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: A struct containing the cleaned markdown string and an array of inline images.

methods.name: preprocess(markdown:)
methods.description: Main function that processes raw markdown input, removing envelope headers, message ID hints, inbound context blocks, timestamps, and extracting inline images.

methods.name: inlineImage(label:source:)
methods.description: Determines if the source string contains a base64-encoded image, and if so, creates an InlineImage object.

methods.name: fallbackImageLabel(_:)
methods.description: Returns a sanitized label for an image, defaulting to 'image' if label is empty.

methods.name: stripEnvelope(_)
methods.description: Removes envelope headers from the raw string if present, based on header patterns or channel prefixes.

methods.name: looksLikeEnvelopeHeader(_)
methods.description: Checks if a given header string resembles an envelope/header, based on regex patterns or known channel prefixes.

methods.name: stripMessageIdHints(_)
methods.description: Removes message ID hint lines from the input string.

methods.name: stripInboundContextBlocks(_)
methods.description: Removes inbound context headers and fenced JSON blocks from the input string, handling metadata sections.

methods.name: shouldStripTrailingUntrustedContext(lines: indices:)
methods.description: Determines if trailing untrusted context sections should be stripped based on specific patterns.

methods.name: stripPrefixedTimestamps(_)
methods.description: Removes timestamp prefixes from each line of the input string.

methods.name: normalize(_)
methods.description: Normalizes line endings and whitespace in the processed string.
